title: BharatBrands Entity
description: A single fintech brand entity with logos and metadata

id.description: Kebab-case unique identifier. Used as folder name and npm export key.

short_name.description: Abbreviated name used in space-constrained UI

categories.description: One or more category tags. An entity can belong to multiple.

logos.description: Logo variants for this entity. A null value means the asset has not been sourced yet; a string is a path relative to the entity folder.

full.description: Symbol + wordmark. Primary logo. Key is required; null until sourced.

mono_dark.description: Single-color version for dark backgrounds (white or light).

mono_light.description: Single-color version for light backgrounds (black or dark).

square.description: Square/app-icon format, used for circular avatar UI.

brand_color.description: Primary brand hex color. Used for UI accent when displaying this entity.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the entity's primary market.

founded.description: Year the entity was founded or launched.

regulated_by.description: Regulatory bodies governing this entity. Array to support dual regulation.

ifsc_prefix.description: 4-letter IFSC bank code prefix. Only for banks.

upi_handles.description: UPI VPA suffixes supported by this entity.

fip_id.description: Account Aggregator FIP ID as registered with Sahamati / ReBIT. Null when present but unverified.

fiu_id.description: Account Aggregator FIU ID. For entities that consume AA data. Null when present but unverified.

aa_id.description: AA operator ID. Only for Account Aggregator entities.

status.description: Current operational status of the entity.

acquired_by.description: The acquiring/successor entity id. Set when the brand is owned by another entity in this dataset, whether or not it still operates independently.

tags.description: Free-form additional tags for search and filtering.

added_at.description: ISO date when this entity was added to the dataset.

updated_at.description: ISO date of the last update to this entity record.

contributors.description: GitHub usernames of contributors who added/maintained this entity.
